title: Service Concession Arrangements
summary: Addresses the accounting for service concession arrangements where a public sector body contracts with a private operator to develop, finance, operate, and maintain infrastructure used to provide a public service.

related.title: Revenue from Contracts with Customers
related.relationship: Governs recognition and measurement of both construction or upgrade and operating or maintenance revenue

related.title: Financial Instruments
related.relationship: Governs subsequent measurement of the financial asset model receivable

related.title: Intangible Assets
related.relationship: Governs subsequent amortisation of the intangible asset model right to charge users

related.title: Borrowing Costs
related.relationship: Governs capitalisation of borrowing costs, available only under the intangible asset model

related.title: Provisions, Contingent Liabilities and Contingent Assets
related.relationship: Governs restoration obligations arising under the concession contract
